title: Lightsout contract (.factory.yaml), factory/v1alpha1
description: A contract declares path access, references to existing CI gates, reviewer agents, lights-on mode and overrides for a directory and everything below it (CON-11). Contracts contain no commands: every object rejects unknown fields (CON-4).

apiVersion.description: Schema version. Must be exactly factory/v1alpha1.

kind.description: Document kind. Must be exactly Contract.

paths.description: Path access rules, anchored at the contract's directory (CON-7).

writable.description: Paths agents may change. Absent means no opinion; an empty list means nothing is writable here or below (CON-7, CON-12).

readOnly.description: Paths agents may only propose changes to; a path owner must approve (CON-7).

sensitive.description: Paths that require the security reviewer (SEC-5).

generated.description: Generated paths, excluded from the review budget (INT-19).

gates.description: References to existing CI gates by trusted producer, pinned workflow revision and check identity (CON-4).

union.description: Smoke and contract gates evaluated at Union (PIP-5).

darkMergeOracle.description: Existing trusted CI comparison used for dark merges (PIP-13). Always mandatory, so it has no mandatory field.

caseManifest.description: The oracle's case manifest, pinned by digest (PIP-13). Only the digest is identity; path says where to read it.

observables.description: What the oracle compares between the old and new behavior.

verify.description: Reviewer agents added at Verify. Adds to the parent's list, never removes.

lightsOn.description: Turns on lights-on mode for this area (CON-8). It can only turn on down the tree (CON-12).

overrides.description: Override fields: the lowest level that sets one wins (CON-9).

switchStaleDays.description: Days before a feature switch is considered stale (CON-9).

switchAbandonedDays.description: Days before a feature switch is considered abandoned (CON-9).

reviewBudgetLines.description: Soft review-surface budget in hand-written changed lines (INT-19).

pattern.description: A path glob anchored at the contract's directory: printable ASCII, no leading slash, none of backslash, [, ], { or }. The rest of the syntax is checked by the glob compiler, not here.

repoPath.description: A repo-relative file path: printable ASCII without wildcards, no leading or trailing slash, no empty, . or .. segment.

name.description: Display name for readers. Never used for identity.

badPathShape.description: Matches a leading or trailing slash, an empty segment, or a . or .. segment.

producerId.description: Trusted CI producer, as kind:id (for example github-app:12345) (CON-4).

workflowId.description: Workflow identity within the producer: a positive integer or a string (CON-4).

workflowRevision.description: Pinned workflow revision: a full lowercase 40- or 64-hex commit ID (PIP-2).

checkId.description: Job or check identity within the registered workflow (CON-4).

gate.description: A reference to an existing CI gate. A gate identified only by name is invalid (CON-4).

mandatory.description: Whether a failing or missing result blocks the change (CON-5).
